reaction: The connection between the lining, fluid and sliding surfaces is clear.
reason: Add the ligaments to support the joint; this is the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect the ligaments to span the elbow and help restrain and stabilize its movement.

effect: The ligaments complete the supported elbow, allowing bending while resisting sideways movement; all chapter goals are complete.
reaction: The movement arrows make the ligaments' stabilizing role clear.

mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the mineralized framework to supplied bone cells brought the structural and living components together in one cutaway, making bone more than an inert scaffold.

leastWorthwhile.text: The bone-cell lineage introduced mesodermal and mesenchymal precursors without explaining those terms, though it did define osteoblasts and osteocytes.

surprise.text: Nutrients reach embedded bone cells through tiny fluid-filled channels, while red blood cells remain in the larger vessel. That clarified how living cells are supplied within bone.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless: the constructions followed the stated bone and joint goals, although the final capsule and ligament steps were the only offered combinations rather than meaningful choices.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: assembling the bone and joint connected material properties to living tissue and movement, even if the later choices were predictable.
